messages:
sarah: Heads-up — customer AcmeCorp reports Console graphs stuck on loading for multiple dashboards. They see spinning panels for ~2 minutes then a 504. They emailed that it started around 09:10 UTC.

mike: Which dashboards / time ranges? any pattern?

sarah: All dashboards using 7d range, but smaller ranges (1h) sometimes load. Happens for a few users in eu-west-1 only.

jess: Saw similar alerts earlier from monitoring: analytics-api latency spike + worker queue growth around 09:05. Correlation id in logs: cid=3f9b2a8c.

eng-sre-bot: alert: analytics-api.high_tail_latency thresholds breached (p95 1.8s -> 12s), queue_length=240.

mike: Can you grab a request id from the console devtools from a failing load? customer gave one: req=6a4f9b2e, cor=3f9b2a8c. Also have a screenshot: https://redwood-internal/screencaps/2145678901.png

jess: Repro steps from customer: 1) login -> 2) open Dashboard "Revenue Overview" -> 3) set time range 7d -> panels show spinner -> after ~120s a 504. They tried hard refresh + different browser, same.

support-eng: I checked routing: requests hit analytics-api-primary in eu-west-1 and were retried twice then 504 from analytics-worker. Relevant log snippet: 
```
[09:06:12] request=req=6a4f9b2e cor=3f9b2a8c backend=analytics-worker attempt=1 status=504 trace=QXz2
[09:06:45] request=req=6a4f9b2e backend=analytics-worker attempt=2 status=504 trace=QXz2
[09:07:18] request=req=6a4f9b2e backend=analytics-worker attempt=3 status=504 trace=QXz2
```

jess: The worker logs show a query fanout to Clickhouse timing out on a long GROUP BY: sql_query_id=qh-88a2, duration=115s, error=timeout after 90s.

mike: Sounds like a bad long-running query is saturating workers and causing queuebacks. Any recent deployments to analytics-worker?

jess: There was a rollout yesterday of a change to the query planner (PR #4821) that adjusted parallelism heuristics. Can we rollback?

sarah: Customer on paid plan; flagged as priority P1. They want ETA. For workaround can we set dashboard default to 1d? They need quick fix for reporting.

mike: Temporary mitigation: reduce query timeout to 30s for dashboard routes (to fail-fast) and enable cached results for 7d range for AcmeCorp org. Will open rollback if needed.

eng-sre-bot: runbook step applied: route-level timeout=30s for /dashboards/* for org=acmecorp. Cache warm job scheduled.

jess: I’ll dig into PR #4821 impact. If we see increased GROUP BY planning causing full-table scans we should revert. Retrieving clickhouse query plan now (qh-88a2).

support-eng: Noted — emailed customer with workaround and asked for any additional affected dashboards.

mike: Next actions: (1) investigate PR #4821 effect on parallelism, (2) check worker autoscale and queue drain metrics, (3) consider rollback if rollback correlates. Assigning to eng-sre.

sarah: Thanks team. I’ll keep the customer updated. :thumbsup:
